calendar.name: U.S. Amateur, U.S. Mid-Amateur & Walker Cup
calendar.description: Confirmed championship dates and locations for the 2027 U.S. Amateur, 2027 U.S. Mid-Amateur and the next Walker Cup in 2028, plus the latest official viewing information.

events.course: Oak Hill Country Club (East and West Courses)
events.viewing: Golf Channel is the announced U.S. rights holder. Exact 2027 broadcast dates and times have not yet been published.

events.course: Jupiter Hills Club (Hills Course; Village Course for stroke-play co-hosting)
events.viewing: No official 2027 television or streaming schedule has been announced.

events.course: Bandon Dunes Golf Resort (Bandon Dunes Course)
events.viewing: Golf Channel is the announced U.S. rights holder. Exact 2028 broadcast dates and times have not yet been published.
events.note: There is no Walker Cup in 2027. The biennial match moved to even-numbered years beginning in 2026.
